status: Teaching taxonomy with four adapted categories. Not the full official PolyNarrative codebook.

labels.name: Criticism of climate policies
labels.definition: The paragraph argues that a climate policy is ineffective, costly, unfair or otherwise harmful.

labels.name: Questioning measurements and science
labels.definition: The paragraph challenges climate measurements, scientific methods, or the trustworthiness of climate science.

labels.name: Downplaying climate change
labels.definition: The paragraph presents climate change or its consequences as exaggerated, minor, or merely a natural cycle.

labels.name: Controversy about green technologies
labels.definition: The paragraph argues that renewable or other green technologies are unreliable, unsafe or harmful.
